text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board to fill two vacancies. The Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Public Library will conduct the interviews at its February 20, 2018 meeting and make recommendations to the Civic Appointments Committee.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Directed that the Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Public Library interview the following candidates on February 20, 2018, for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board: Candidate #155 Candidate #391 Candidate #396 Candidate #492 Candidate #507 Candidate #524 Candidate #567 Candidate #669 2. Direct that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 12, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
